Sanjay: Heads-up — canary (dedicated-sm86, flash runtime v2->v3 rollout) showing ~18% token latency regression for certain prompts. Correlates with head_dim=30 and causal=true. Repro steps below.
Chris: ugh that's bad. can you paste the profiler output?
Sanjay: profiler snippet:
```
kernel_picker: chose flash_v3_causal_headaligned
seqlen=2048, batch=1, head_dim=30, sm=86
exec_ms: 1.98  (expected ~1.65 with flash_v2)
kv_cache_copy_ms: 0.12
overhead_ms: 0.05
```
Linda: interesting — head_dim 30 is an oddball for our tiling heuristics. we usually optimize for multiples of 16/32.
Kevin: do we fall back to a slower path because head_dim%8 != 0? what are the kernel constraints?
Maria: flash_v3 has a new packing kernel that prefers head_dim%16==0 or head_dim==64 fallback; otherwise it uses a generic slower kernel. v2 used an intermediate optimized path for 30 that v3 removed.
Chris: can we change kernel_picker to prefer v2 for head_dim in {22,30,46} on sm86 until v3 gets an optimized path?
Sanjay: quick experiment: forcing v2 for head_dim==30 reduces exec_ms back to 1.66.
perfbot: [profiling alert] canary: dedicated-sm86 - 18% regression detected on route /generate for model rwd-llama-7b-quant, correlation: head_dim=30, seq=2048.
Linda: what's the distribution of head_dim in prod? are these models common?
Maria: we saw ~7% of requests in last week had head_dim not divisible by 16, mostly smaller fine-tuned variants and some community models.
Kevin: suggests a hybrid selector: architecture-aware + headdim-aware. propose ruleset:
```
if sm>=86:
  if causal:
    if head_dim % 16 == 0: pick flash_v3_causal_packed
    elif head_dim in small_odd_set: pick flash_v2_causal_opt
    else: pick flash_v3_generic
```
Sanjay: also need seq-length hysteresis — we've seen seqlen>=1024 prefers different tiling. maybe attach seqlen buckets.
Maria: agree. add seqlen bucket 'LONG' for >=1024 that biases towards kernels with better memory access even if slightly slower for short seq. prevents flip-flopping during middling requests.
Chris: any KV cache interaction? Could the cache copy be amplified by v3 path?
Sanjay: kv copy times similar; main diff is the compute kernel. but v3's shared memory layout causes worse bank conflicts for head_dim=30 on sm86 according to microbench.
Linda: who can prototype selector change? If small patch and runtime flags we can do a short canary.
Kevin: i'll implement selector rule + flag gate. will add telemetry counters: chosen_kernel, head_dim, seqlen_bucket, exec_ms.
Maria: add a rollout plan: flag off in prod, enable on canary pool, monitor 24h, then widen.
Chris: also open an issue to upstream flash_v3 team with microbench details and repro so they can implement packing for odd head sizes.
Sanjay: thanks. documenting repro and patch plan in PR.
deploy-bot: deploy request created: PR #4821 - runtime: kernel selector heuristic for sm86 causal odd head dims. region: canary-dedicated. :rocket: 
Maria: nice. please keep perf dashboard alert thresholds tighter while this is rolling. :eyes: 
Kevin: will do. starting implementation now.
